question: Does the measured Kodak total-film MTF need to replace the existing generic forward-scatter, development-adjacency and dye-diffusion small-signal budget, or can it be composed without double counting?

arms.measured_total: exact discrete response of the P5L total-film LOD
arms.legacy_total: analytic product of generic forward scatter, linearized P5C adjacency and dye diffusion at the same physical frequencies

branch_rule.mixed_or_above_unity_residual: close additive positive composition; measured total replaces all three generic film small-signal spatial stages in any later Kodak-250D look challenger
branch_rule.positive_residual_feasible: freeze and validate a separately versioned positive residual compiler; do not assign physical causes from mathematics alone
branch_rule.parent_or_numerical_failure: retain P5L reference evidence only and close budget integration

forbidden: multiply measured total-film MTF by the full generic film spatial chain
retain P5C sharpening merely because it was previously severe-clean
fold scanner MTF into film MTF or stock identity
infer exposure, process, layer or dye-cloud component truth from one total MTF graph
use negative taps or an unconstrained sharpening residual to force a fit
claim calibrated roll, process, scanner, colour or product response
claim_ceiling: Small-signal spatial-budget attribution for one manufacturer total-film MTF curve family; no identified internal decomposition, roll/process/scanner calibration, photographic value or product promotion.
